d:
Experience the divine energy and powerful beats of “Om Ganapataye Namaha Deva” from the movie Banjo. Blending devotion with contemporary sound, this energetic track invokes Lord Ganesha while carrying the raw, earthy musical vibe of the film. Sung by Nakash Aziz and Vishal Dadlani, the song stands out for its spirited vocals and impactful composition by Vishal & Shekhar.
Song Name: Om Ganapataye Namaha Deva
Singers: Nakash Aziz, Vishal Dadlani
Music: Vishal & Shekhar
Lyrics: Amitabh Bhattacharya
Movie: Banjo
Lyrics of Om Ganapataye Namaha Deva - om ganpatye nam deva
om ganapataye ganapataye
